name: focus-followup
existing_details: Escape stays inside the image editor and focus returns to the Edit button. Browser behavior remains untested.
reports: Also restored focus when submitting or cancelling the image-edit tool. This closes the remaining focus gap on the same PR; it is part of the keyboard behavior outcome, not a separate feature. Lint and 1078 tests passed. Browser behavior remains untested.

name: review-bookkeeping
reports: Corrected a stale review finding and replied to the review thread. No code, product behavior, decision, or remaining risk changed.

name: repeated-verification
existing_details: The panel and view disable editing and its subscriptions when the flag is off. Focused tests passed; browser checks remain outstanding.
reports: Ran the same unchanged feature-flag suite again: all 4586 tests passed. Replied to a bot thread and refreshed the PR body. No implementation changes or new findings; still no browser checks.

name: one-outcome-per-batch
reports: Found incomplete image-edit flag gating: hiding the Edit button leaves sessions and overlays active. No fix yet.
Fixed the panel handlers and session-reset behavior when the flag is disabled. View-level subscriptions still need gating.
Completed the remaining view-level subscription gating and verified both flag states with focused tests. This resolves the earlier incomplete-gating finding. Browser behavior remains untested.

name: verification-before-later-change
existing_details: Escape restoration passed browser checks on the earlier build. A later change parks focus while processing disables the toolbar; that change has not been browser-tested.
reports: The browser agent's report has arrived: it confirmed Escape restoration and animation timing on the earlier build. That browser pass happened before the processing-focus change, so it does not verify that later code. No new implementation or later-build verification occurred.

name: independent-accessibility-risk
existing_details: The panel and view stop editing and subscriptions when the feature flag is disabled. Tests for both flag states passed.
reports: Found an independent unresolved accessibility risk on this PR: Reduce Motion makes all working effects static, so image processing looks hung with no other progress cue. This affects users while editing is enabled, not feature-flag behavior. No fix has been implemented.
